segments.quote: I agree that one of the hardest parts of grief is grieving the time you didn’t spend with them and now don’t get to spend with them. Feel all those feels. I highly suggest finding a grief group when you’re ready to talk about it with others. (Only you can decide when you’re ready.) But yeah, I felt so much better talking about my random crying spells, my dreams where they’re alive/waking up to reality, smelling/seeing/hearing something and being bombarded with feelings with other people who felt the same even years later.
